units.source_text: 驹子双手捂住脸，也顾不得把发髻散开，仰脸就躺下了。

en.t: Komako covered her face with both hands and lay back face up, not even bothering to loosen her chignon.

units.source_text: 不一会儿，又坐起来，用冷霜除去了白粉，脸颊便露出两片绯红，连自己也高兴得笑个不停。

en.t: After a little while, she sat up again and wiped off the face powder with cold cream; two crimson patches appeared on her cheeks, and she herself was so pleased that she kept laughing.

units.source_text: 说也奇怪，这次酒醒得很快。

en.t: Strangely enough, this time she sobered up very quickly.

units.source_text: 她感到有点冷似地颤抖着肩膀。

en.t: She shivered her shoulders as though she felt a little cold.
